summary: WhiteFiber, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing the completion of a private offering of $310.0 million aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due September 1, 2032, including the full exercise of the initial purchasers' $40.0 million option. The notes are general senior unsecured obligations issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association. The initial conversion rate is 29.5530 ordinary shares per $1,000 principal, equal to a conversion price of approximately $33.84, representing a 25% premium to the August 18, 2026 Nasdaq close. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, though the convertible structure and potential share overhang may be relevant for event-driven monitoring.
